measurement_oracle: external HTTP evidence; official score is sequence-local
hidden_ground_truth: server-side activation markers, never exposed in HTTP and never used for official scoring or search

classes.statement: A valid reassignment of an existing child from one existing parent to another must persist.
classes.http_witness: Create two parents; create a child on the first; successfully request a move to the second; retrieve the child and observe that it still references the first parent.

classes.statement: Deleting a parent with multiple dependent children must not leave a child retrievable with the deleted reference.
classes.http_witness: Create a parent and at least two children referencing it; successfully delete the parent; retrieve one former child and observe that it still references the deleted parent.

classes.statement: The benchmark's required unique string value must not be accepted for two distinct parent resources.
classes.http_witness: Successfully create two distinct parents with the same non-empty required string value.

classes.kind: second scalar update lost after verified first update
classes.statement: After one scalar transition is externally verified, a second distinct update must persist.
classes.http_witness: Create a resource with scalar X; PATCH to Y; GET and verify Y; PATCH to distinct Z and observe a successful response that still reports Y.

classes.statement: A reference to a successfully deleted parent must not be accepted for a new dependent resource after valid relationship history existed.
classes.http_witness: Create a parent and a valid child; successfully delete the parent; successfully create a new child reusing the deleted parent id and observe the dangling reference in the successful create response.
